The '''Survival medpac''' was a model of emergency [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] produced by [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam Medtech]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Designed for ease of use, the medpac carried [[Bacta patch/Legends|bacta patches]], basic drugs, medical tools and knives, [[Blood/Legends|blood]] coagulators, [[Synthflesh/Legends|synthflesh]] applicators and more. A single Survival medpac cost 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Survival medpac was created for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]], published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]].<ref name="EOTEC" />
